summary: Liveranov announces his participation in the All-Star Night Rift Showdown event representing The Dark Lady faction. Players can back his team in-game by selecting The Dark Lady faction, binding liveranov as their God Envoy, and selecting a Preacher from the same faction. Participation between September 15 and September 29 unlocks rewards such as Heliolite Dice, Wyrmarrow, official merch, and physical figures.
tips: Choose The Dark Lady faction in-game and bind liveranov as your God Envoy on the creator event page.
Add 1 Preacher from the same faction to complete your event registration.
Remain active in-game between September 15 and September 29 to maximize rewards for the faction.
title: Support Me in Dragonheir: All-Star Night — Bind the Dark Lady! #dragonheirallstarnight
